789 Assos {as'-sos}

probably of foreign origin;; n pr loc

AV - Assos 2; 2

Assos = "approaching"
1) a seaport of the Roman province of Asia in the district anciently
   called Mysia, on the north shore of the Gulf of Adramyttium, and
   about 7 miles (11 km) from Lesbos
